article_context: 文章质疑把塑料污染责任主要交给个人消费者的做法，认为购物袋、吸管等个人行动容易形成“道德许可”，真正大规模改变行为需要税收、禁令、回收便利等结构性政策，同时仍保留公民推动改革的责任。语气应有公共议题评论的清晰立场，但保持克制。

article.title: 阅读 Text 4 · 塑料危机不能只靠个人消费选择
article.background: 文章质疑把塑料污染责任主要交给个人消费者的做法，认为购物袋、吸管等个人行动容易形成“道德许可”，真正大规模改变行为需要税收、禁令、回收便利等结构性政策，同时仍保留公民推动改革的责任。语气应有公共议题评论的清晰立场，但保持克制。

sentences.en: Arnold Schwarzenegger, Dia Mirza and Adrian Grenier have a message for you: It's easy to beat plastic.
sentences.zh: 阿诺德·施瓦辛格、迪娅·米尔扎和阿德里安·格雷尼尔想对你说：战胜塑料并不难。

segments.text: Arnold Schwarzenegger, Dia Mirza and Adrian Grenier have a message for you: It's easy to beat plastic.

sentences.en: They're part of a bunch of celebrities starring in a new video for World Environment Day - encouraging you, the consumer, to swap out your single-use plastic staples like straws and cutlery to combat the plastics crisis.
sentences.zh: 他们和一群名人一起出演了世界环境日的新视频，鼓励作为消费者的你，用别的东西替代吸管、餐具等一次性塑料日用品，以应对塑料危机。

segments.text: They're part of a bunch of celebrities starring in a new video for World Environment Day - encouraging you, the consumer, to swap out your single-use plastic staples like straws and cutlery to combat the plastics crisis.

sentences.en: The key messages that have been put together for World Environment Day do include a call for governments to enact legislation to curb single-use plastics.
sentences.zh: 世界环境日汇总的核心信息中，确实包括呼吁各国政府立法限制一次性塑料。

segments.text: The key messages that have been put together for World Environment Day do include a call for governments to enact legislation to curb single-use plastics.

sentences.en: But the overarching message is directed at individuals.
sentences.zh: 但贯穿其中的总体信息，主要还是面向个人。

segments.text: But the overarching message is directed at individuals.

sentences.en: My concern with leaving it up to the individual, however, is our limited sense of what needs to be achieved.
sentences.zh: 然而，我担心的是，一旦把这件事主要交给个人，我们对真正需要实现什么的认识就会过于有限。

segments.text: My concern with leaving it up to the individual, however, is our limited sense of what needs to be achieved.

sentences.en: On their own, taking our own bags to the grocery store or quitting plastic straws, for example, will accomplish little and require very little of us.
sentences.zh: 比如，仅靠自己带购物袋去超市或不用塑料吸管，能实现的改变其实很少，而我们付出的也几乎微不足道。

segments.text: On their own, taking our own bags to the grocery store or quitting plastic straws, for example, will accomplish little and require very little of us.

sentences.en: They could even be detrimental, satisfying a need to have "done our bit" without ever progressing onto bigger, bolder, more effective actions - a kind of "moral licensing" that allays our concerns and stops us doing more and asking more of those in charge.
sentences.zh: 这些行动甚至可能适得其反：它们满足了我们“已经尽过一份力”的心理需要，却让我们不再迈向更大、更大胆、更有效的行动——这是一种“道德许可”，会缓解我们的不安，也让我们不再多做一步，更少去要求掌权者承担更多责任。

segments.text: They could even be detrimental, satisfying a need to have "done our bit" without ever progressing onto bigger, bolder, more effective actions - a kind of "moral licensing" that allays our concerns and stops us doing more and asking more of those in charge.

sentences.en: While the conversation around our environment and our responsibility toward it remains centered on shopping bags and straws, we're ignoring the balance of power that implies that as "consumers" we must shop sustainably, rather than as "citizens" hold our governments and industries to account to push for real systemic change.
sentences.zh: 当有关环境以及我们对环境责任的讨论仍围绕购物袋和吸管打转时，我们其实忽视了背后的权力结构：它让我们以“消费者”的身份被要求可持续消费，却没有以“公民”的身份追究政府和企业的责任，推动真正的系统性改变。

segments.text: While the conversation around our environment and our responsibility toward it remains centered on shopping bags and straws, we're ignoring the balance of power that implies that as "consumers" we must shop sustainably, rather than as "citizens" hold our governments and industries to account to push for real systemic change.

sentences.en: It's important to acknowledge that the environment isn't everyone's priority - or even most people's.
sentences.zh: 我们必须承认，环境并不是每个人最优先考虑的事情，甚至不是大多数人的首要任务。

segments.text: It's important to acknowledge that the environment isn't everyone's priority - or even most people's.

sentences.en: We shouldn't expect it to be.
sentences.zh: 我们也不该期待人人都把它放在第一位。

segments.text: We shouldn't expect it to be.

sentences.en: In her latest book, Why Good People Do Bad Environmental Things, Wellesley College professor Elizabeth R. DeSombre argues that the best way to collectively change the behavior of large numbers of people is for the change to be structural.
sentences.zh: 韦尔斯利学院教授伊丽莎白·R·德松布尔在新书《为什么好人会做出坏的环境行为》中提出，要集体改变大量人群的行为，最有效的办法是让改变具有结构性。

segments.text: In her latest book, Why Good People Do Bad Environmental Things, Wellesley College professor Elizabeth R. DeSombre argues that the best way to collectively change the behavior of large numbers of people is for the change to be structural.

sentences.en: This might mean implementing policy such as a plastic tax that adds a cost to environmentally problematic action, or banning single-use plastics altogether.
sentences.zh: 这可能意味着实施塑料税，让对环境有问题的行为付出成本；也可能意味着彻底禁止一次性塑料。

segments.text: This might mean implementing policy such as a plastic tax that adds a cost to environmentally problematic action, or banning single-use plastics altogether.

sentences.en: India has just announced it will "eliminate all single-use plastic in the country by 2022."
sentences.zh: 印度刚刚宣布，将“在2022年前消除全国所有一次性塑料”。

segments.text: India has just announced it will "eliminate all single-use plastic in the country by 2022."

sentences.en: There are also incentive-based ways of making better environmental choices easier, such as ensuring recycling is at least as easy as trash disposal.
sentences.zh: 还可以用激励型办法，让更环保的选择变得更容易，比如确保回收至少和丢弃垃圾一样方便。

segments.text: There are also incentive-based ways of making better environmental choices easier, such as ensuring recycling is at least as easy as trash disposal.

sentences.en: DeSombre isn't saying people should stop caring about the environment.
sentences.zh: 德松布尔并不是说，人们应该停止关心环境。

segments.text: DeSombre isn't saying people should stop caring about the environment.

sentences.en: It's just that individual actions are too slow, she says, for that to be the only, or even primary, approach to changing widespread behavior.
sentences.zh: 她只是认为，个人行动推进得太慢，不能成为改变广泛社会行为的唯一办法，甚至也不该是主要办法。

segments.text: It's just that individual actions are too slow, she says, for that to be the only, or even primary, approach to changing widespread behavior.

sentences.en: None of this is about writing off the individual.
sentences.zh: 以上这些并不是要否定个人的作用。

segments.text: None of this is about writing off the individual.

sentences.en: It's just about putting things into perspective.
sentences.zh: 只是要把个人行动放到恰当的位置上看待。

segments.text: It's just about putting things into perspective.

sentences.en: We don't have time to wait.
sentences.zh: 我们没有时间继续等待。

segments.text: We don't have time to wait.

sentences.en: We need progressive policies that shape collective action (and rein in polluting businesses), alongside engaged citizens pushing for change.
sentences.zh: 我们需要能够塑造集体行动、约束污染企业的进步政策，也需要积极参与的公民持续推动改变。

segments.text: We need progressive policies that shape collective action (and rein in polluting businesses), alongside engaged citizens pushing for change.
